economic_hypothesis: A large down session with unusually high turnover records observable forced supply and an objective average transfer cost. If price remains below that cost for several sessions and later retests then closes back above it with strong price progress, high close location, and renewed turnover, demand has paid through the seller's cost rather than merely benefiting from quiet supply.

seller_anchor: most recent eligible session from signal minus 20 through signal minus 3
anchor turnover >= 1.5 times its strictly prior 20-session mean
anchor close location <= 35 percent of its completed range
anchor key cost equals raw amount divided by raw volume, mapped into the anchor coordinate system
inventory_pressure: every intervening completed close remains strictly below the frozen anchor key cost
all anchor-through-signal rows remain on the same coordinate lineage and pass required validity
demand_reclaim: signal low touches or trades below the frozen anchor key cost
signal close is at least 0.5 percent above the frozen anchor key cost and not below the anchor close
signal turnover >= its strictly prior 20-session mean
signal is not an upper-limit close
rules.deduplication: first qualifying signal per symbol followed by a 20-session cooldown

execution.entry: first legal non-upper-limit open in signal plus one through three
execution.profit_target: +10 percent from executable entry, first eligible from the first sellable session
execution.time_stop: first legal sellable open after the H20 completed-session decision
